scope: Historical original captured pixels and recorded identity association only. No model execution, hardware connection, sharpening, AI reconstruction, or synthetic detail.
coordinate_mapping: PNG is native RGB888 793x317 with no scale/rotation. local_xyxy = source_xyxy - [575,375,575,375]. ROI origin is fixed in all recorded frames.
annotation_policy: Editing labels ID 880 and boxes are drawn from the real tracking row raw_box; ID 880 is a track identity, while resistor face marking 473 and class A are not identity IDs.

model_record_only.note: Historical acquisition provenance; not a new model selection or deployment.

lifetime_within_recorded_clip.visual_qa: Viewed first/middle/last candidate frames and the selected three. The target remains the black 473-marked resistor face moving left to right. This is a limited video evidence review, not a dataset accuracy/physical acceptance claim.

excluded_candidate.reason: Earlier track observations change class/physical appearance, so it is excluded as a reliable example.
